relationships.subject: bariatric surgery
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP level (252.7 to 130.1, p < 0.001) were significantly reduced after surgery

relationships.subject: bariatric surgery
relationships.evidence_quote: Bariatric surgery decreases the frequency of migraine attacks, lessens the severity of headaches

key_findings: Bariatric surgery in obese chronic migraine patients reduced attacks, disability and serum CGRP, with CGRP changes tied to weight-related variables.
